title: Rav Kahana bar Bizna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports Rabbi Shimon Chasida (א״ר שמעון חסידא): he is mentioned in Yalkut, Ezekiel, remez 347, saying, “Were it not that the coals had cooled,” etc. Hyman calls this a scribal error, for the statement comes from Yoma 77a, and there it is Rav Chana bar Bizna.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Yoma 77a has Rav Chana bar Bizna reporting Rabbi Shimon Chasida. Kahana is Hyman’s heading for the reading he rejects; the transmission and Hyman’s emendation remain distinct.

The consulted Yoma 77a has Rav Chana bar Bizna reporting Rabbi Shimon Chasida. The intended Yalkut Ezekiel passage could not be established by the attempted lookup. Hyman's Kahana heading and scribal-error assertion remain his textual comparison; the positive Yoma passage does not prove a printed correction history.
